t: This is Broadcasting House, the headquarters of the BBC, standing on Portland Place and Langham Place. The first radio broadcast came from here on the fifteenth of March 1932, and the building was officially opened two months later. It's Art Deco, faced in Portland stone over a steel frame, and it's Grade Two star listed. Inside is the BBC Radio Theatre, where programmes are recorded before a studio audience. Val Myer was appointed by the BBC to design it, as one of the first purpose-built broadcasting buildings in the world. Raymond McGrath, an Australian-born architect, also designed it, including its interiors.
